decision_summary: QIF v0.6.36 is approved for release with illustrative-evidence limitations explicit.
rationale: The implementation aligns schema, example, verifier, fixtures, authoring guidance, roadmap, and runtime evidence; all structural tests pass and Guardian boundaries prevent operational metrics from becoming quality or blame claims.
recommendation: Commit, tag, push, and publish v0.6.36; then begin v0.6.37 Reviewer Disagreement Calibration.
